references.text: Jesus mentions the harvest and the workers in connection with the harvesting of souls, which prepares the reader for the prayer for workers in the next verse.
Immediately after Jesus' call to pray for workers, he calls his twelve disciples and gives them power, demonstrating the fulfillment of the prayer for workers for the harvest.
Luke repeats the concept of the harvest and the need for workers, emphasizing the importance of the prayer that Jesus taught his disciples in Matthew.
